extracted.name: Hot Toddy
extracted.description: A hot toddy cocktail is a warming whiskey drink made with hot water, honey, and lemon. Though hot toddies are known as cold remedies, we love to make this recipe throughout the fall and winter. It's so cozy on a cold night!
ingredient_lines: 1 cinnamon stick (or 3 whole cloves, optional, for garnish)
instruction_lines: In a mug, stir together the hot water, whiskey, lemon juice, and honey until the honey dissolves. Taste and adjust as desired.
Garnish with the lemon round and cinnamon stick, if using.
categories: how to make a hot toddy
